models_evaluated: IMPROVE-DD venous thromboembolism risk model (International Medical Prevention Registry on Venous Thromboembolism plus D-Dimer) EHR-integrated CDS

links.outcome: Thromboprophylaxis, thromboembolism, major bleeding, and 30-day all-cause mortality in CDS versus usual-care hospitals
links.effect: CDS raised appropriate thromboprophylaxis and lowered total thromboembolism (2.9% vs 4.0%, OR 0.71). Major bleeding did not differ. Mortality was higher at intervention hospitals (9.1% vs 7.0%, OR 1.32, 95% CI 1.15-1.53).
links.quote: Mortality was higher at intervention hospitals (9.1% vs 7.0%, OR: 1.32, 95% CI: 1.15-1.53).

screen.reason: This cluster-randomized trial evaluates the real-world deployment of an EHR-embedded predictive risk CDS tool compared to usual care on clinician prescribing and clinical patient outcomes.
